proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7978 pavana wind explicitly supplies Prakrit pavaṇa/payaṇa and modern pavaṇ/pauṇ. Eastern pobon/pəbən responses preserve the fuller pavana stem, with v/b and vowel realization qualified; the relation identifies the family without deciding learned reinforcement or local IA borrowing. Exact response: pəu̯bən.
